summary.text: Jim Joy is a Republican member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 4B, in office since January 2023, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026, against Democrat Thaddeus Laugisch. Ballotpedia says his career includes owning a business and serving as a reserve police officer.

paragraphs.text: Jim Joy grew up in Detroit Lakes, Minnesota, and lives in Hawley.
Ballotpedia says his career includes owning a business and being a reserve police officer, and that he began serving as mayor of Hawley.
Joy defeated John Hest in the November 8, 2022, general election for District 4B and defeated Thaddeus Laugisch on November 5, 2024.
For 2025-2026 he is co-vice chair of the House Taxes Committee and serves on the House Transportation Finance and Policy and State Government Finance and Policy committees.
